# Lifecycle fragment conversion rows. See README.md for tags.
# init runs for real in the fixture project: --force replaces its .env. The quiet
# row goes first and writes AGENTS.md without a word, so the second row prints the
# same stderr on every one of its runs. start, stop and restart cannot finish on
# the fixture (no docker-compose.yml; --skip-build keeps start from generating
# one). Check their error envelopes here; TestLifecycleJSON covers success.
init --quiet --force --non-interactive --name smoke --domain example.test
init --force --non-interactive --name smoke --domain example.test
start --skip-build #| error-json=E004
stop #| error-json=E400
restart #| error-json=E400
